hope

youth

Read the passage and check your answers.
Liang Qichao and
“The Young China"
1 Liang Qichao was a well-known writer and educator
in China. He wrote many articles to encourage and
guide young people. "The Young China" is one of his
most famous works.
2 The turn of the 20th century was China's darkest
moment. The country and its people faced great
difficulties. Liang believed that young people were
the hope of the nation. In "The Young China"， he
called on young people to shoulder the responsibility
and take action to make China strong and energetic.
3 Liang strongly believed in the strength of young people.
He described them as full of energy and hope. He was sure
that they could build a bright future for China.

外语教学与研究出版社
这外语教学与研究出版社
4 Below are the best-known lines from "The Young China". The
sentences are short, but the message is clear: when young people grow，
the nation grows, too. Although it would be a hard task, Liang believed
that China's youth would make history. His words still encourage
today's teenagers to work hard for the future of the country.
•The duty of the times falls on us youth alone.
If we are wise, China will be wise；
If we are wealthy, China will be wealthy；
If we are strong, China will be strong；
If we are independent, China will be independent；
If we are free, China will be free；
' Blue sky over our heads, yellow earth under our feet.

Presenting ideas
Recommend a role model for your class.
Step
Work in groups. Search for the following information about teenagers with
achievements in different fields. Then take a group vote to decide on your role model.
• country
• field
• actions
• age
• achievement
• qualities
Step
Organise your ideas with the help of the following outline and write your
recommendation. You may use the following language tips or find useful
expressions or sentences from this unit.
Introduction stating the purpose or main idea of your recommendation
- I would like to recommend... as a role model for our class.
- My role model is...
- Iam going to introduce to you my role model...
Body
Describing the basic facts of your role model
Explaining the key qualities of your role model
- He / She was born in /into...
- He / She helps to solve..
- He/ She.. at the age of...
- He/ She is good at..
- .. is a well-known...
- .. really admire him / her because..
- He / She has drawn attention
- He/ She didn't give up.
both from home and abroad.
- He / She takes the responsibility and
takes action to...
Conclusion Ending your recommendation with comments on your role model
- I believe we can all learn a lot from my role model...
- I hope you like my role model..
- He / She sets a good example for us.

hope

youth

Read the passage and check your answers.
Liang Qichao and
“The Young China"
1 Liang Qichao was a well-known writer and educator
in China. He wrote many articles to encourage and
guide young people. "The Young China" is one of his
most famous works.
2 The turn of the 20th century was China's darkest
moment. The country and its people faced great
difficulties. Liang believed that young people were
the hope of the nation. In "The Young China"， he
called on young people to shoulder the responsibility
and take action to make China strong and energetic.
3 Liang strongly believed in the strength of young people.
He described them as full of energy and hope. He was sure
that they could build a bright future for China.

4 Below are the best-known lines from "The Young China". The
sentences are short, but the message is clear: when young people grow，
the nation grows, too. Although it would be a hard task, Liang believed
that China's youth would make history. His words still encourage
today's teenagers to work hard for the future of the country.
•The duty of the times falls on us youth alone.
If we are wise, China will be wise；
If we are wealthy, China will be wealthy；
If we are strong, China will be strong；
If we are independent, China will be independent；
If we are free, China will be free；
' Blue sky over our heads, yellow earth under our feet.

Presenting ideas
Recommend a role model for your class.
Step
Work in groups. Search for the following information about teenagers with
achievements in different fields. Then take a group vote to decide on your role model.
• country
• field
• actions
• age
• achievement
• qualities
Step
Organise your ideas with the help of the following outline and write your
recommendation. You may use the following language tips or find useful
expressions or sentences from this unit.
Introduction stating the purpose or main idea of your recommendation
- I would like to recommend... as a role model for our class.
- My role model is...
- Iam going to introduce to you my role model...
Body
Describing the basic facts of your role model
Explaining the key qualities of your role model
- He / She was born in /into...
- He / She helps to solve..
- He/ She.. at the age of...
- He/ She is good at..
- .. is a well-known...
- .. really admire him / her because..
- He / She has drawn attention
- He/ She didn't give up.
both from home and abroad.
- He / She takes the responsibility and
takes action to...
Conclusion Ending your recommendation with comments on your role model
- I believe we can all learn a lot from my role model...
- I hope you like my role model..
- He / She sets a good example for us.
